title: The Forgotten Salt
author: Petra Halloran
blurb: Odile Ravensworth, an exiled storm-caller, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
